_note: The Day 2 (Malware) fight. Same format as response_day1.json. The deck and the upgrades come from Hardening. Each pattern has one upgrade that counters it (counter); without it the pattern plays in its harsh version (harsh), announced by the harder line of that defense. Kinds: disguise (reveal: how far across the box a bullet is when it turns hostile, as a share of the box width; a large number means it is shown as what it is from the start), split (generations, split_after, split_angle), flicker (period, visible: the share of the period a bullet can be seen). works_note is shown once, at the start of the pattern, when the counter is equipped. A defense with helper_warning (seconds) delays the start of every pattern by that long. finish is the results screen, as on Day 1.

comments.flawless: Joshua: Nothing got through. Recovery only needs a final check.
comments.won: Joshua: {threat} is stopped. These got through: {names}. Recovery will repair them.
comments.lost: Joshua: {threat} got through. Check your upgrades and your deck, then try again.

defenses.name: Block Unknown Programs
defenses.works: Only approved programs ran. The gifts showed what they really were, so you saw them coming.
defenses.harder: No Block Unknown Programs: the trojan looks harmless until the last moment, and it comes in bigger waves.

defenses.name: Keep Software Updated
defenses.works: The hole was patched, so each copy could only split once.
defenses.harder: No Keep Software Updated: the worm uses an old hole, so every copy splits again.

defenses.name: Antivirus Always On
defenses.works: The antivirus found the spyware, so it could not hide.
defenses.harder: No Antivirus Always On: the spyware hides, and only a faint trace is left.

defenses.name: Scan Attachments
defenses.works: The scan spotted the attack early, so you had a little more time.

patterns.name: Trojan
patterns.teach: It looks useful, like a free tool. It is not what it says.
patterns.say: A free tool, just for you.
patterns.works_note: BLOCKED: shown as what it is

patterns.name: Worm
patterns.teach: It copies itself to the next computer, and the next.

patterns.name: Spyware
patterns.teach: It hides, and it watches what you type.
patterns.say: You will not even know I am here.
